js: const st = window.__ensemble.getState(); const chat = await window.ensemble.createChat({ title: 'Pricing page' }); await st.openChat(chat.id); const lead = st.accounts.find(a => a.provider === 'claude' && !a.configDir) || st.accounts[0]; window.__chat = chat.id; await window.ensemble.send({ chatId: chat.id, to: lead.id, text: 'Add a pricing page with three tiers. Simulate a limit while you are at it.', mode: 'quick' }); return 'sent to ' + lead.name
const s = window.__ensemble.getState(); const c = s.chats.find(x => x.id === window.__chat); return 'cover: ' + JSON.stringify(c && c.cover) + ' lead: ' + c.leadId

window.__ensemble.setState(s => { const u = s.usage['claude-3']; return { usage: { ...s.usage, ['claude-3']: { ...u, supply: { state: 'low', until: Date.now() + 2 * 3600e3, window: 'session' } } }, chats: s.chats.map(c => c.id === window.__chat && c.cover ? { ...c, cover: { ...c.cover, back: true } } : c) } }); return 'patched: Claude 3 running low, Main back'
window.__ensemble.setState(s => ({ chats: s.chats.map(c => c.id === window.__chat && c.cover ? { ...c, cover: { ...c.cover, back: false } } : c) })); return 'hand-back not offered yet'
